### Faith Is a Verb
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-july-3-2025.html
Passage: Judges 4:6-9
Points:
- True faith originates in God's revealed word rather than mere human optimism or self-reliance.
- God gave clear instructions and promised victory to Barak through the prophetess Deborah.
- Believing God's promise required Barak to move beyond passive agreement into concrete action.
- Genuine faith acts as a verb by stepping forward in obedient trust.

### Deborah Leads the Way
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-oct-25-2010-11639914.html
Passage: Judges 4:14
Points:
- Deborah encouraged Barak to rise up because the Lord was already marching ahead of the army.
- When Barak hesitated to lead without her presence, Deborah supported him instead of shaming or replacing him.
- She went to the front lines to help him focus on God's power rather than nine hundred enemy chariots.
- Believers are called to use their words to embolden others and help them fulfill their God-given roles.

### Bible Pathway - Mar. 23, 2012
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-mar-23-2012.html
Passage: Judges 4:14
Points:
- Deborah's steadfast trust in God's word gave her courage to urge Barak into battle.
- Barak feared confronting Sisera's formidable army and iron chariots without spiritual support.
- Deborah declared the day of deliverance, affirming that the Lord had gone out before them.
- Deliverance comes through relying on the Spirit rather than earthly strength or military power.

### Deborah
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/deborah
Passage: Judges 4:4
Points:
- God raised up Deborah as a prophetess and judge during twenty years of severe Canaanite oppression.
- Humanly speaking, Israel faced impossible odds against Jabin's advanced military technology and iron chariots.
- Barak hesitated to lead the fight alone, relying on Deborah's presence and losing the primary battlefield honor.
- God delights to work through ordinary and unexpected people to accomplish His redemptive purposes.
